Build a two-way permalink converter for AT Protocol.

Paste a Bluesky web URL (https://bsky.app/profile/<handle-or-did>/post/<rkey>) and get back the canonical at:// URI (at://<authority>/app.bsky.feed.post/<rkey>). Paste an at:// URI and get back the bsky.app URL. Detect which direction the input implies and convert accordingly — do not make the user choose a direction.

This is pure string parsing. Make NO network calls of any kind; everything is local computation on the input.

Alongside the converted output, break out the parsed components (authority, collection, rkey) in a small labelled table, so the page doubles as an explainer for how AT URIs are structured. Note in the copy that an at:// URI with a handle authority is not canonical — the canonical form uses the DID — and that resolving one to the other needs a network lookup this page deliberately doesn't do.

Handle malformed input with a clear inline message naming what was wrong (missing rkey, unrecognised collection, not a bsky.app URL) rather than failing silently or showing a stale result. Add a copy-to-clipboard button on the output, and three clickable examples covering both directions including one with a did: authority.
